work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: The act grants rochet and violet mozzetta to the choral beneficiaries of San Medardo, Arcevia. Issuer evidence GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF11563; own dating clause LF11656–11659 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die’ decima sexta decembris millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo primo, pon- tificatus Nostri anno primo.. Own provenance note LF11580 excluded as edition furniture. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
